summary: Tested Hebrew translations on SubleasesTab, SubleaseForm, SavedSearchesTab, and BulkUploadModal. All 4 components mostly render Hebrew labels correctly, but found ONE CRITICAL bug: the 'Rental type' dropdown options in the SavedSearches create-alert form render literally as 'savedSearches.undefined' five times instead of resolved Hebrew labels (כל סוג, טווח ארוך, טווח קצר, נופש, אחסון). All other targeted Hebrew labels from the i18n diff render correctly. No i18next missing-key console warnings observed.

ui_bugs.issue: Dropdown options render literally as 'savedSearches.undefined' five times instead of the translated Hebrew labels. The RENTAL_TYPES list passes `tk` keys to t() but the values come back undefined. i18n.js HAS the keys (anyType='כל סוג', longTermLabel='טווח ארוך', shortTermLabel='טווח קצר', vacationLabel='נופש', storageLabel='אחסון') under savedSearches.* — likely `tk` is being concatenated to `savedSearches.` literally instead of resolving, OR the tk values on the RENTAL_TYPES entries are missing/wrong. Visible in /tmp/alerts_he.png.

'New alert' heading, 'We'll watch for new matches…' subtitle, 'AREA' label, 'Tip: leave any field blank…', 'Cancel' button and 'Create alert' submit button remain in English even in Hebrew mode. These appear to be outside the keys added in this PR but live in the same form the task asked us to verify.
'Your Sublease Listings' heading still in English even though i18n.js has sublease.listingsTitle='רישומי תת-שכירות שלך'. The component doesn't wire that key.

action_items: FIX (HIGH): In SavedSearchesTab.jsx, the RENTAL_TYPES tk keys are resolving to 'savedSearches.undefined' — verify the array's tk fields hold real key names ('anyType', 'longTermLabel', 'shortTermLabel', 'vacationLabel', 'storageLabel') and that t() is invoked as t(`savedSearches.${row.tk}`). The console shows no missing-key warning, suggesting the string 'savedSearches.undefined' is what is being passed (so row.tk is undefined on every row).
Wire t('sublease.listingsTitle') into SubleasesTab.jsx — i18n key already exists but the JSX still hardcodes 'Your Sublease Listings'.
Optional: extend i18n + wire it for the CreateAlertForm chrome — heading 'New alert', subtitle, 'AREA' label, tip line, 'Cancel'/'Create alert' buttons (currently English in Hebrew mode).
critical_code_review_comments: RENTAL_TYPES.tk wiring in SavedSearchesTab.jsx is broken — produces literal 'savedSearches.undefined' rather than localized labels. Easy regression to ship because the new section in i18n.js (anyType / longTermLabel / shortTermLabel / vacationLabel / storageLabel) is correct, only the consumer is wrong.
sublease.listingsTitle defined in i18n.js but unused in SubleasesTab.jsx → dead key.
All other Hebrew-label wiring tested in this PR works correctly with no i18next missing-key warnings.

Also verify BulkUpload (owner@test.com → 'העלאה מרוכזת' button → expand 'Import CSV / XLSX' panel) — that panel was confirmed PASS for ייבוא מגיליון אלקטרוני / העלה .csv או .xlsx / textarea placeholder 'שורות מופרדות בטאב או פסיק...' / title='שכפל שורה זו' & 'הסר שורה זו' / and the gotListingsFrom callout. SubleasesTab header subleaseYour + newSublease button + Step 1 title + bookedElsewhereBtn all confirmed in Hebrew on renter dashboard. Console produced 0 i18next missing-key warnings, so the bug is purely a wrong reference, not a missing translation.
rca of the issue: SavedSearches RENTAL_TYPES dropdown shows 'savedSearches.undefined' 5x. Reproduction: login as renter, switch to Hebrew via header toggle, open 'התראות' tab, click 'צור התראה חדשה'. The 'סוג שכירות' <select> has 5 options each labeled 'savedSearches.undefined'. Root cause: the consumer (likely in SavedSearchesTab.jsx CreateAlertForm) calls t(`savedSearches.${tk}`) where tk is undefined on every RENTAL_TYPES row — either the rows lost their tk fields, or the render is using a wrong property name. Mitigation: add a tk field on each RENTAL_TYPES row matching one of {anyType, longTermLabel, shortTermLabel, vacationLabel, storageLabel} and use that in the t() call.
